messages.subject: Opinion - Ashfield Dynamics v Marwick Drives
messages.plaintextBody:
Tom,

My Opinion is in your inbox via the usual portal. In short: strong on liability, with the clause 11 limitation as the principal risk (prospects ~60-65%). I value the claim on a risk-adjusted basis at £290k-£320k and would not advise accepting below £275k. Mediation is the right forum.

Harriet

messages.subject: Counsel's advice & next steps
messages.plaintextBody:
David, Helen,

Harriet Stanford has advised. Headline: a strong claim, but the limitation clause is a genuine risk, so a negotiated outcome is sensible. Her risk-adjusted valuation is £290k-£320k plus costs, and her floor is around £275k. She recommends mediation, which Marwick have also floated.

With your authority we'll propose a mediation in early November and aim to settle in that range.

Tom

Whitfield Carter LLP | 22 Bishopsgate, London EC2N 4BQ | www.whitfieldcarter.com
Confidential and may be legally privileged.
